method: Exact complete source excerpt and mapped node span continuity; CP287 row/node/scope mapping, CP292 complement checked, exact CP301 remaining owner ID subset, disjoint from independently read prior CP293–301 and earlier staged scopes.

groups.title: Proof guard
groups.meaning: Null level/event or event outside exclusive horizon returns null; no substitute timestamp.

groups.title: Exact recorded timestamp
groups.meaning: as_decimal level; second_times if not None, else derive; bisect left and inspect only contiguous equal-time rows. Bearish high > level, otherwise low < level; equality excluded; first crossing returns recorded event. Fallback main-open not intrinsically tagged, may pass if exact evidence exists.

groups.title: Stop view
groups.meaning: Null/out-of-horizon main stop nulls both fields; otherwise retain main time and independently prove event. No local exception catch.

groups.title: Reaction confirmation
groups.meaning: Native confirmation with intrabar flag; bullish box top else bottom. Catch AttributeError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError only for retrieval. Opposite direction and proof outside catch. Native confirmation can cache/fall back to main open.

groups.title: Physical identity
groups.meaning: Optional First/Break pair, missing either null, int conversion and canonical pair, errors propagate.

groups.title: Projection index
groups.meaning: Retain market/directions; map prepared audit by converted native pair, later duplicate overwrites; references retained.

groups.title: Physical Order bounds
groups.meaning: Null prepared null; entry/reaction required; both indices independently in [0,len candles), no relative-order constraint.

groups.title: Physical view
groups.meaning: Optional crossed triple positions 1/2, native confirmation in order direction, main candle first/break times and exact stop price string; horizon/proof stop view.

groups.title: Parent Order
groups.meaning: Use recorded formation identity only, final audit lookup or null, delegate physical formatter.

groups.title: Creator prerequisites
groups.meaning: Require strict stop event and source time; otherwise null; final audit causes only.

groups.title: Parent-stop match
groups.meaning: Exact parent type, source time and event; requested family None accepts None/empty only, otherwise exact family.

groups.title: Reset-leg and ambiguity
groups.meaning: Exact postBehaviorType or generic E/StopAll for requested prefix; exact source/stop times; no family test for reset-leg; ignore other kinds. Distinct physical identity dedup, exactly one match else null.

groups.title: Audit causes
groups.meaning: Invalid physical view RuntimeError; parent-stop required keys and normalized family/times; reset-leg copy keys, datetime-only conversion; ignore other kinds, retain encounter order.

groups.title: Audit schema
groups.meaning: Direction/mode normalized, physical first/break plus int indices; box strings including str(None) from missing default; stop level/source time and stoppedAt, causes; no sort.
